description: This file provides core service functions for processing usage events, training a machine learning model, and generating shutdown recommendations within a backend application.

methods.name: List[UsageEvent] ingest_events_from_rows(rows: Sequence[dict])
methods.description: Converts raw dictionary rows into UsageEvent objects, parsing start and end times.

methods.name: dict train_usage_model_from_events(events: Iterable[UsageEvent])
methods.description: Builds features from usage events and trains a RandomForest model.

methods.name: ShutdownRecommendation get_shutdown_recommendation(user_id: str, instance_id: str, threshold: float = 0.3)
methods.description: Loads the latest trained model to compute weekly shutdown recommendations for a user and instance.

ctags.name: get_shutdown_recommendation
ctags.pattern: /^def get_shutdown_recommendation(user_id: str, instance_id: str, threshold: float = 0.3) -> Shutd/
